properties.displayName: UAV S20 - Unauthorized MAVLink Injection (Failsafe Suppression Observation)
properties.description: UAVMavsec_CL에서 COMMAND_LONG/PARAM_SET 명령 중 Failsafe 관련 파라미터(FS_GCS_ENABLE/FS_EKF_THRESH/FENCE_ENABLE 등)를 대상으로 하는 명령의 SourceSystemId가 Approved_SystemId_List(UAVId별 인가 SystemId)에 없으면 비인가 주입에 의한 Failsafe 억제 시도로 탐지. MITRE: T1692 / MITRE ICS ATT&CK: T0842(Network Sniffing 계열 — Enterprise 근접기법 T1040으로 매핑)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let failsafeParams = dynamic(['FS_GCS_ENABLE', 'FS_EKF_THRESH', 'FENCE_ENABLE', 'FS_THR_ENABLE', 'FS_LONG_ACTN']);
let ApprovedSystems = _GetWatchlist('Approved_SystemId_List') | project SystemId = toint(SystemId), UAVId;
UAVMavsec_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where Command in ('COMMAND_LONG', 'PARAM_SET')
| where isempty(TargetParam) or TargetParam in (failsafeParams)
| join kind=leftouter (ApprovedSystems) on $left.SourceSystemId == $right.SystemId, UAVId
| extend SourceSystemIdAnomaly = isnull(SystemId)
| where SourceSystemIdAnomaly
| extend TriggerReason = strcat('MAVLink_비인가주입_Failsafe억제_SourceSystemId:', tostring(SourceSystemId), '_Param:', TargetParam)
| extend Severity = 'High'
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, SourceSystemId, Command, TargetParam, SourceSystemIdAnomaly, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S20 - Unauthorized MAVLink Injection (Failsafe Suppression Observation) - {{UAVId}}
